images.caption: A field of different colored Irises on a farm near Traverse City, MI.

brief: A resort-town cottage lot: a white one-and-a-half-storey farm cottage behind an iris field. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: northern Michigan resort cottages of this kind are 1880-1950 buildings; Commons has almost no newer ones. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: a white 1.5-storey shed-house at an iris farm (Grand Traverse County MI, c.1920) behind a field of bearded irises in bloom; black shutters, a white board fence

why.note: a farm building whose 'yard' is a crop field
